Initial release — create shareable videos from text or image prompts using cloud GPU rendering.

- No editing skills required: simply describe the video you want, upload files, and receive a ready-to-share video.
- Automatic session and token management, with 100 free credits for new users and 7-day validity.
- Features include video generation, file upload, credits check, real-time status updates, and export/download.
- Clear user prompts and API error handling for a smooth workflow.
